text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it was left on? There's nobody here 
anymore, right... Alright.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... the lights...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I wonder where the switch is. 
Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Call... Call... Intercepting "ROWA". ...Is 
the transmission originating from here?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Universe-san.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love... Incident? An anomaly in 
space?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Something wrong...? N-No. Someone just 
turned off the lights... that's all.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."Quintessence".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
We need to "jam" her laps. Neo Universe is 
about to "EVA."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's with this poster... Is it a 
cipher? This definitely wasn't here last 
night, right...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Intercept the variable star," it says. Is 
this a prank by someone...? It's kind of 
creepy.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe denies "debris." She thought 
to "bounce" and "posted" it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is this a prank from you, 
Universe-san? Come on, don't scare me like 
that~!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""FOBN"... that is, in "Mission 
Control"..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um, e-excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Still-san!? Since when...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry. Regarding that 
poster— I do not believe it is a prank.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Universe-san is not the type of person to 
do such a thing, so...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
!! Yes! The "AGC" that saves Still in Love 
from the "Dark Matter"...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"With this flyer? Dark matter... variable 
stars... coming to save me—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, c-could it be...?! Did you miss 
the notice that says, 'Make sure nobody is 
inside before turning off the lights'..?!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Is it the kind intended for everyone? Ah, 
sorry. If that's the case, I'll be 
careful!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Launch Failure"... She couldn't pass 
through the "filter"...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... please, don't be so down... You 
did it out of the goodness of your 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe gives "thanks." I'm glad 
you're not "Alphard."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-Not at all... If anything, that was 
something I should have insisted on.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Shall we help each other out whenever 
trouble arises? We are roommates by fate, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...!! "Myu-tef"... "Myu-tef"!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The flight crew supports each other. We 
will become the "Bussard ramjet"...!

—And so Neo Universe explained everything 
that had happened in the dorms from 
beginning to end.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
From here on in the "Sleep Compartment", 
no matter what happens, we'll clear it as 
"mates".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ANS" has increased... We can "advance" 
even further...!
choice_data_list: I see. Keep getting along well, okay!
I see. Keep being good friends, okay?

Let's help each other out and make dorm 
life comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ANS" has increased... We can "advance" 
even further...!
choice_data_list: I see. Keep getting along well, okay!
I see. Keep being good friends, okay?

Let's help each other out and make dorm 
life comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Copy...!" Neo Universe attempts to 
"connect."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... signs of Voyager 
vanishing? I can compute a 'fun' 
probability."
choice_data_list: I'm sure every day will be a blast.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
That would be "WCOM"! I'm going to go ask 
Still in Love, "Please let me"...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love's state lies beyond the 
"surface of last scattering."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I'll go "receive" and see if there is a 
"REQU"...!

Neo Universe is actively trying to connect 
with someone. Seeing her take that step 
brings a feeling of genuine joy!
